A01.remediation: Add middleware (`r.Use(auth.RequireAuth)`) and per-handler ownership checks (`if resource.UserID != currentUserID { c.AbortWithStatus(403) }`).

A02.remediation: Use `golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt` for passwords. Use `crypto/rand` for tokens. Move secrets to env / Vault.

A03.remediation: Use `db.Query("SELECT … WHERE id = ?", id)` with `?` placeholders. Pass argv lists to `exec.Command`; avoid `sh -c`.

A05.remediation: Restrict CORS via `github.com/gin-contrib/cors` with explicit `AllowOrigins`. Build with `-trimpath`, strip debug.

A07.remediation: Use `bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword`. Compare tokens with `subtle.ConstantTimeCompare`. Enforce MFA via TOTP.

A09.remediation: Use `log/slog` or `zerolog` with structured fields. Log auth, authorization and admin events with user id, IP.

A10.remediation: Validate and allowlist outbound URLs. Resolve DNS yourself to block private IPs. Disable HTTP redirects (`client.CheckRedirect = func(...) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }`).
